caption: This is Ganja Ramen, featuring a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork slices and green onions. The bowl, with its red geometric rim, sits on a black tray under warm lighting, highlighting the savory, inviting appearance of the noodles and toppings.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with smooth texture and natural wood finish.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with marbled fat, showing tender texture and slight browning on its surface.
The miso broth is light brown, creamy, and glossy, with visible noodles, green onions, and black pepper floating on its surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric patterned rim and smooth, glossy surface.
